title: Distinguish missing evidence, wrong selection, weak prose and a bad evaluator rule
summary: When a sentence is vague, inspect whether good evidence was written weakly, evidence was absent from the brief, the wrong accomplishment was selected, or the evaluator applied a bad rule.
body: When a sentence is vague, inspect whether good evidence was written weakly, evidence was absent from the brief, the wrong accomplishment was selected, or the evaluator applied a bad rule. Only weak wording over good evidence primarily calls for prompt repair. Word ranges guide writing rather than trigger rejection loops; a useful mechanism/output need not carry a numerical metric.
